scenario.name: Restored atmosphere short real-input workload probe
scenario.entryRequirement: Use explicit --level 2-1 or 1-4 in an isolated release browser. This is an effect-cost diagnostic, not normal-home or full route acceptance.

environment.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (0x00002191) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

scope: Fresh isolated browser profile does not guarantee empty OS/driver caches. No QA publisher. CDP TaskDuration is renderer main-thread task time, not isolated Godot CPU or GPU duration. GL wrappers measure synchronous API latency and add overhead. First action and repeated action must both be present and visually verified. Collection completion is not a frame-budget or gameplay pass.
